author: Dex
title: Banana Ball Is Coming Back to Jacksonville in 2027! - NewsBreak
text:
By Dex ,
1 hours ago SAVANNAH, GEORGIA - FEBRUARY 25: Reece Hampton #6 of the Party Animals is tagged out at home plate by Bill LeRoy #1 of the Savannah Bananas during their home opener at Grayson Stadium on February 25, 2023 in Savannah, Georgia. The Historic Grayson Stadium is the home of the independent professional baseball team called the Savannah Bananas. The Bananas were part of the Coastal Plain League, a summer collegiate league, for seven seasons. In 2022, the Bananas announced that they were leaving the Coastal Plain League to play Banana Ball year-round. Banana Ball was born out of the idea of making baseball more fast-paced, entertaining, and fun. (Photo by Al Bello/Getty Images) By Al Bello Jacksonville is getting another round of Banana Ball! The wildly popular baseball experience has announced its 2027 schedule , and VyStar Ballpark will host the Loco Beach Coconuts and Party Animals on March 5 and 6, 2027 . If you’ve never experienced Banana Ball, think baseball mixed with dancing, crazy trick plays, hilarious entertainment and plenty of surprises. It’s become one of the hottest tickets in sports!
The Jacksonville stop is just one part of a massive 2027 season. Walt Disney World will host the Banana Ball Open April 15–18 , bringing all six teams to Orlando, while St. Petersburg will welcome the Loco Beach Coconuts and Savannah Bananas May 7–8 . The tour is also going international for the first time, with stops in Mexico and Canada. Want tickets for Jacksonville? You’ll need to enter the official lottery at BananaBall.com before October 31, 2026 . Entering doesn’t guarantee tickets, but it gives you a chance to purchase them if selected.
